entries.input: 19.1 How many Annual Leave days do I receive?
entries.output: Eligible regular employees receive 18 days of Annual Leave per calendar year. Employees joining during the year receive a prorated entitlement.

entries.input: 19.2 Can I carry forward unused Annual Leave?
entries.output: Yes. Up to 10 unused Annual Leave days may normally be carried forward to the following calendar year.

entries.input: 19.3 What happens to unused Casual Leave?
entries.output: Unused Casual Leave normally expires at the end of the calendar year and cannot normally be carried forward.

entries.input: 19.4 Do I need approval before taking leave?
entries.output: Yes. Planned leave should be submitted through the designated HR system and approved before the leave begins.

entries.input: 19.5 What happens if I forget to mark attendance?
entries.output: Submit an attendance correction request through the designated system, normally within two working days of the missed entry.

entries.input: 19.6 What are the standard working hours?
entries.output: The standard schedule is 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday, unless a different schedule applies to your role.

entries.input: 19.7 Is there a grace period for late arrival?
entries.output: Yes. A 15-minute grace period is provided for occasional delays. Arrival by 9:45 AM falls within the grace period. The grace period is not intended to become a regular revised start time.

entries.input: 19.8 Can I work from home when I am sick?
entries.output: If you are unwell but still able to work, you may request temporary Work From Home where your role permits it. If you are unable to work, use the applicable Sick Leave process.

entries.input: 19.9 Can I work remotely from another country?
entries.output: Not without prior written approval. International remote work may require additional review for tax, immigration, security, legal, and client-related requirements.

entries.input: 19.10 Can I install software on my company laptop?
entries.output: Only authorized software should be installed. Use the company approved software catalogue or IT support process when requesting new software.

entries.input: 19.11 What should I do if I lose my company laptop?
entries.output: Report the loss immediately to the IT or Information Security team. Do not delay reporting the incident.

entries.input: 19.12 Can I accept a gift from a vendor?
entries.output: Modest and customary non-cash gifts may be acceptable when they do not influence business decisions and comply with company policy. Cash and cash-equivalent gifts must not be accepted.

entries.input: 19.13 How do I report harassment?
entries.output: Report harassment to your reporting manager, People & Culture, the designated Ethics or Compliance contact, or another applicable confidential reporting channel.

entries.input: 19.14 Can I report a concern anonymously?
entries.output: Where a confidential or anonymous reporting channel is available, employees may use that channel subject to its operating rules.

entries.input: 19.15 How often are performance reviews conducted?
entries.output: Formal performance reviews are generally conducted twice each year, with informal feedback provided throughout the year.

entries.input: 19.16 Can I get reimbursed for a professional certification?
entries.output: You may request reimbursement for an approved certification relevant to your role, subject to eligibility, prior approval, budget, and applicable reimbursement requirements.

entries.input: 19.17 What is the notice period?
entries.output: Your notice period is determined by your employment agreement. Different requirements may apply during probation or for different employment categories.

entries.input: 19.18 Can I leave before completing my notice period?
entries.output: You may request an early release, but approval is subject to business requirements, your employment agreement, and company procedures.

entries.input: 19.19 What happens to my benefits after resignation?
entries.output: Some benefits may continue until your final working date, while others may end earlier according to the applicable benefit plan. Contact People & Culture for details.

entries.input: 19.20 Who should I contact if I cannot find an answer in this handbook?
entries.output: Contact the People & Culture Department through the designated employee support channel. Specialized matters may be directed to Payroll, IT, Finance, Information Security, or another appropriate team.

entries.input: 20. Important Contacts
entries.output:
General HR / Employment: People & Culture
Leave and Attendance: People & Culture
Payroll and Salary: Payroll Team
Benefits and Insurance: People & Culture / Benefits Support
IT Support: IT Helpdesk
Information Security: Information Security Team
Workplace Harassment: People & Culture / Designated Complaints Channel
Ethics and Compliance: Ethics & Compliance Team
Business Travel: Finance / Travel Desk
Expense Reimbursement: Finance Team
Performance Management: Reporting Manager / People & Culture
Learning and Development: Learning & Development Team

Employees should use official internal contact details and support channels published on the company employee portal. For emergencies involving immediate danger to health or safety, contact appropriate local emergency services first.
